title: The Sabbath Day Belongs to God
description: This week on "The River Church" podcast, Pastor Chris Zehner continues to explore the theme "The Church is a Place of Healing", emphasizing the importance of setting aside Sundays for worship and prioritizing our relationship with God. Join Pastor Chris as he shares powerful insights from Exodus 20, highlighting the biblical significance of observing the Sabbath day and making it a non-negotiable part of our weekly worship. Don't miss this impactful message that will challenge and inspire you to prioritize your relationship with God.
